reviews.title: Better than OEM.
reviews.comment: I like these much better than the Sennheiser mics because they work easily with Invisilavs. The newer Sennheiser design has a screen head that gets in the way. The cable on this is more durable too. They sound great!
reviews.author: Bill D.

reviews.title: Good for the value
reviews.comment: It sounds good using it with mi Comica pro
reviews.author: Daniel Hernandez

reviews.title: Works Great!
reviews.comment: Really like the sound quality on this mic. It's really tough getting the clip-on to go on but once it's on you'll love the sound.
reviews.author: S. K.

reviews.title: Super recomendado
reviews.comment: Igual o mejor que el original, me sorprendió, lo único diferente es que el cable es un poco más grueso, pero funciona perfecto, muy bueno.. recomendado con toda!
reviews.author: Gerardo Alzate Zuluaga
